input.free_text_description: The system operates in the messaging, content management domain. It serves API Consumer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include api, file, index. Core business data revolves around RoncooUserDao, RoncooUserDaoImpl, RoncooUserLog, RoncooUserLogCacheImpl. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents as needed.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage api operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage index operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage rest roncoo operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
